perplexity.description:
Nobody Loves You More is Kim Deal's debut solo album, released in 2024 on 4AD. The 11-track collection represents Deal's first official solo project and draws from over a decade of material, with its earliest songs dating back to 2011, shortly after her departure from the Pixies. The album features contributions from her sister Kelley Deal and former collaborators from the Breeders, including drummer Jim MacPherson and bassist Mando Lopez, alongside guest appearances from Savages members Fay Milton and Ayse Hassan, Teenage Fanclub's Raymond McGinley, and Jack Lawrence of the Raconteurs.

Musically, the album demonstrates considerable stylistic range, moving from vibrant, brass-infused bossa nova arrangements on the title track to raw, vulnerable songwriting on tracks like "Are You Mine?" The record notably includes "A Good Time Pushed," recorded during the final sessions at Steve Albini's Electrical Audio studio in Chicago before his death in May 2024. Singles released ahead of the album's launch included "Coast," "Crystal Breath," "A Good Time Pushed," and the title track.

Critical reception has been positive, with AllMusic awarding the album their Editor's Choice designation and praising it as "some of her finest music yet," noting that while individual songs would stand out within her other projects, they gain added resonance as part of her solo work. The Quietus similarly highlighted the album's stylistic diversity and emotional depth, underscoring Deal's distinctive voice as a solo artist.
